subject: MAP wiring session & evaluation ownership — Nova Clinical POC
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Gomez <ella@novaclinical.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP wiring session & evaluation ownership — Nova Clinical POC

Ella / team — thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we want to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align success criteria, evaluation benchmarks, and ownership for the proof-of-concept. Proposed agenda below and a first-pass MAP attached (MAP-v1.xlsx).

Agenda (30–45 min):
- Introductions & roles (internal + Nova)
- Success criteria (clinical accuracy, latency, integration checkpoints)
- Benchmark plan and datasets (who supplies what)
- Ownership: prompts, evals, infra, and SLOs
- Timeline to decision (contracting + pilot completion)

Quick asks for this week: please confirm:
1) Who from Nova will own clinical validation and data provisioning (name + email).
2) Any hard constraints on latency or hosting (VPC/on-prem).
3) A preferred time for the wiring session — we have availability Tue/Wed morning PST.

For internal alignment: Marcus will lead benchmarking/specs, Monica will own success criteria and onboarding, Priyom will lead commercial cadence, and Rafael is on-call for engineering escalations.

Attachments: MAP-v1.xlsx (first draft), benchmark-specs.md (skeleton) — I’ll update after we confirm owners.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0191 | hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP wiring session & evaluation ownership — Nova Clinical POC

Thanks, Hannah — this looks good. A few quick answers:  
- Clinical validation owner: Dr. Ella Gomez (ella@novaclinical.com) — I’ll be the day-to-day POC.
- Data provisioning: we can share de-identified test sets; procurement needs a data-sharing addendum.
- Latency constraint: <500ms 95th for inference in our EU-facing apps; US pilot is more flexible but we prefer VPC for the pilot.

We can do Tue 10/13 at 9:30am PST for the wiring session. Please send a calendar invite.

On attachments: I see MAP-v1.xlsx — I’ll upload a simple dataset manifest after internal review.

Best,
Ella
Director of Clinical AI | Nova Clinical

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ella Gomez <ella@novaclinical.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP wiring session & evaluation ownership — Nova Clinical POC

Great — jumping in with a benchmarking plan sketch (attached: benchmark-specs.md). A few engineering notes for the call:
- We’ll need a representative CSV with ~500–1,000 de-id records for prompt rounds 1–3. If Nova prefers, we can provide a synthetic generator to expand to larger sizes.
- Plan to run three evaluation axes: clinical accuracy (custom labels), hallucination rate (QA checks), and latency/cost (per-token).
- Suggested owners:
  * Prompt engineering & eval design: Marcus Lin (marcus_lin@redwood.ai) + Nova clinical SME (Ella)
  * KV-cache + throughput config: Rafael Mendes (rafael_mendes@redwood.ai)
  * Trial infra & VPC setup: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.ai)

I’ll prep a short script and sample eval harness and share before Tue. Reference files: benchmark-specs.md, MAP-v1.xlsx.

Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Gomez <ella@novaclinical.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP wiring session & evaluation ownership — Nova Clinical POC

Thanks Ella — confirming Tue 10/13 9:30am PST. I’ll join to walk through contract timeline and a compressed commercial path that matches your procurement windows. High level:
- Pilot dates: target kickoff 10/20, 4-week evaluation (complete by 11/17).
- Decision checkpoint: partner review + clinical signoff by 11/17; contracting to follow (suggested 2-week turnaround).
- If procurement needs tighter SLAs during pilot, we can offer a temporary service-level addendum for the evaluation period.

Procurement: please confirm if a standard MSA with a single addendum for data sharing will work or if you require additional reviews. Happy to route to legal immediately if that accelerates.

Pricing note (for internal team): anticipate a discounted pilot rate for the 4-week PoC; I’ll share details on the call.

Regards,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Gomez <ella@novaclinical.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: MAP wiring session & evaluation ownership — Nova Clinical POC

Thanks all — quick operational checklist for the wiring session and immediate next steps:

Pre-call (before Tue 9:30am PST):
- Nova: confirm dataset owner and upload manifest (Ella) — ACTION: Ella
- Procurement: indicate preferred MSA path or data addendum (Procurement team) — ACTION: Procurement
- Redwood (Marcus): share eval harness and a short runbook (done by start of day Tue) — ACTION: Marcus

Success criteria (draft — please comment during call):
1) Clinical accuracy: target F1 >= 0.88 on the labeled subset agreed in the dataset manifest.
2) Safety/hallucination: <2% critical hallucination rate on the audit set.
3) Latency: 95th percentile <500ms for the US pilot; EU-facing constraint evaluated separately.
4) Integration: API contract verified and a working VPC proof-of-connectivity.

Post-call deliverables (owners & ETA):
- Updated MAP with timelines and owners (Hannah) — ETA 10/14 EOD
- Baseline eval run and results file (Marcus) — ETA 10/22
- Procurement MSA path confirmation (Procurement) — ETA 10/16

I’ll produce a short one-page SRE checklist for the VPC setup and share it in the Drive link during the call. Looking forward to the session.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: MAP-v1.xlsx, benchmark-specs.md
